policy.source_content_verified_rule: True only after lawful inspection of an authoritative full artifact.
policy.storage_rule: No artifact is stored unless its storage and redistribution basis is known; remote inspection does not imply redistribution permission.
policy.degradation_rule: Transport or API degradation is recorded as degraded, not unmatched.
